title: Gufic Biosciences Appoints IIT Bombay PhD Dr. Reeta Shah as Independent Director

contentHtml:
Mumbai: Gufic Biosciences Limited has announced the appointment of Dr. Reeta Shah as an Additional Director in the capacity of Non-Executive Independent Director for an initial term of five consecutive years, effective December 1, 2026.

Dr. Reeta Shah brings over 38 years of professional experience across finance, education and administration. She is a Chartered Accountant and holds a Ph.D. in Finance from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay, an LL.B. degree and three Master’s degrees. Her extensive academic and professional background includes leadership positions at SIES College and ITM EEC.

Throughout her career, Dr. Shah has been associated with several premier educational institutions, including IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi and IIM Indore. Her experience also includes serving as an Independent Director at Shemaroo Entertainment Limited for a period of 10 years, providing her with substantial exposure to corporate governance and board-level responsibilities.

Also Read: Gufic Biosciences Reappoints Pankaj Jayakumar Gandhi as Whole-Time Director for Five Years

In addition to her academic and corporate experience, Dr. Shah is a TEDx speaker, international keynote speaker and growth strategist. She has also been actively involved as a panelist and trainer at conferences and seminars organised by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) and other reputed institutions.

According to the company’s regulatory filing, Dr. Shah is not related to any of the existing directors of Gufic Biosciences Limited. The company has also confirmed that she is not debarred from holding the office of director by any order issued by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) or any other such authority.

The appointment adds an experienced professional with a diverse background in finance, education, administration and corporate governance to the company’s Board. Her association with leading academic institutions and previous experience as an Independent Director are expected to bring valuable perspectives to board-level discussions and governance responsibilities.

Gufic Biosciences Limited is a Mumbai-based pharmaceutical company engaged in the pharmaceutical sector, with its corporate office located in Vile Parle (East), Mumbai. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Gujarat and Karnataka, including locations in Navsari, Vapi and Belgaum. Its business presence across pharmaceutical manufacturing and related activities forms part of India’s broader pharmaceutical industry.
